verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe the dot as an always-on cloud agent with its own computer and browser that keeps working even when your computer is off. It runs background agents in parallel, can delegate to Work or Codex with an Activity view for inspecting delegated work, and reaches out with results or decisions, for example preparing bug fixes "for your review." Together this covers delegating a multi-step task, background autonomous execution, and returning results for review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor documentation.
